say:0:1421156001:0.text: We've taken up so much of your time for something so trivial... I don't know what to say.
say:0:1421156001:0.source_cn: 真是麻烦您了，一路前前后后陪着我们胡闹了这么久……
say:0:1421156001:0.male: We've taken up so much of your time for something so trivial... I don't know what to say.
say:0:1421156001:0.female: We've taken up so much of your time for something so trivial... I don't know what to say.

say:1:1421156002:0.text: It's not every day I get to witness the debut of a new minstrel.
say:1:1421156002:0.source_cn: 能亲眼见证一位新诗人的诞生，也是难得的经历。
say:1:1421156002:0.male: It's not every day I get to witness the debut of a new minstrel.
say:1:1421156002:0.female: It's not every day I get to witness the debut of a new minstrel.
